body.x: Mandatory safety, communication and account-handling rules for all VIP RTN staff.

x: Never take work outside, at any time.
Short power cut: use a mobile data hotspot until power returns.
Long power cut: reschedule your day off or apply for leave.
Always log out of Line OA, Livechat and the BO after work, or when leaving your workstation for a long time.
Always use Incognito mode, so no history is stored on your device (see the Incognito Browsing SOP).
Always use the VPN during work (NordLayer, server M01, M02 or M03).
Never save work on your laptop. All work goes through the drive or Lark sheets.
Do not tell friends or family what you do. Protect yourself.

head: Topic
Rule
Why
rows: Recognise external accounts (clearly marked). Do not accept or reply to any external contact, especially impersonators with similar names
Impersonators try to breach our systems
Be careful with new Telegram accounts sending private messages. Do not reply; report to your direct superior at once
Scammers use new accounts. Not reporting = formal warning letter
All work matters are discussed in official group chats only. Private messages for work are strictly prohibited
Group chats give transparency and supervision. Violation = warning letter or termination
No one may ask for bank app authorisation, OTP codes or financial approvals by private message
A common scam and data-breach tactic
Any BO access or reset request goes through official group channels and the proper procedure
Prevents unauthorised access; keeps change control
All work chat happens in official groups monitored by the HOD. Side groups without the HOD are not allowed and must be closed
Transparency; lets the HOD oversee operations

x: Sign in to the Handbook App with your company email. A personal email is allowed only if it is registered with your ATL first.
The first sign-in with a personal email waits for admin approval. Do not share or forward your sign-in with anyone.
Use the Handbook App as the only current version of SOPs and policies. The old HANDBOOK(new) workbook is kept for reference only.
Do not copy, screenshot or share Handbook content outside the department.
Access is removed the same day a staff member resigns, is terminated, or moves out of the department.
Report lost access, or a login you do not recognise, to your ATL at once.
Breaking any communication or security rule may lead to immediate disciplinary action, up to termination.
All staff complete a security awareness acknowledgement at onboarding and every year after.
